newer_accepted_decision_verbatim.rationale: A reported randomized double-blind crossover in21 healthy male recreational endurance runners compares one50g Risulose isomaltulose dose in400ml water with equal-mass named maltodextrin/glucose preparations after overnight fast,30minutes before shared prescribed running. After10minutes60%Vmax warm-up,60minutes70%Vmax with sampling interruptions and15minutes passive recovery, TTE at85%Vmax was9.22±4.37/8.70±3.28/9.25±3.50min for isomaltulose/maltodextrin/glucose, P=.876, partial eta squared .004: no detected comparative benefit, not equivalence. Lower post-ingestion glucose/insulin/GIP and reported glucose fluctuation remain metabolic results. Controlled oxygen/substrate/RER AUC and trajectory interaction nulls, within-time effects and missing RPE/lactate/HR/correlation results are preserved. Figure3percent versus bodymg/dL, the insulin abstract/body CI difference, GIP timing wording and fat time-effect interpretation remain unresolved as printed. TTE-specific test, complete paired endpoint denominators, period/carryover modeling, precision, prospective hierarchy and multiplicity are unknown or incompletely described. GI means2.26±1.65/2.24±1.48/1.98±1.13, P=.119, partial eta squared .008 remain nonzero; larger-dose pilot intolerance is separate and unquantified. The low-glucose fractions20.4/31.3/28.6% are repeated measurements, not participant incidence. This acute preparation-specific comparison does not establish generic isomaltulose efficacy, chronic muscle renewal, BUB1B/MVA rescue or superiority to provisional project leaders. Nominees and eligibility coverage remain unchanged.
newer_accepted_decision_verbatim.identity_limit: Only the named administered Risulose preparation and exact acute dose/population/protocol are appraised. Lot/purity/CoA, energy equality, retail equivalence and exact independent cohort-family identity remain unknown. Empty aliases prevent generic isomaltulose, Palatinose, isomaltose, comparator carbohydrate and retail products from inheriting this appraisal. Adds one source-specific appraisal, no new chemical, eligibility screening record or verified independent trial/cohort.
